verdict.rationale: Exporting the data a product holds is a fair question for hardware security keys and HSMs, which store user credentials and key material, so the axis applies. The pack documents no capability to export all user data in open formats. The only nearby items are an AES-encrypted key-escrow backup on the older Nitrokey HSM and a community report that attestation certs can't be exported via PKCS#11 and use a non-standard container format. Open-source firmware and the nitropy CLI are adjacent openness features, not data export.
